name: com.coffeebean.save
description: Save system module for the CoffeeBean framework: MemoryPack-based binary serialization (pluggable ISaveSerializer, JSON fallback), AES encryption, atomic write with crash-safe rollback, auto-save with throttling, version migration. Depends on com.coffeebean.tools and com.cysharp.memorypack.

samples.description: 存档模块示例：保存/读取（MemoryPack）、AES 加密、自动存档、版本迁移演示。
